text:
Alex (AE): Quick heads-up 1 FinTech prospect wants a regional pilot: EU-only request handling, customer-managed KMS (BYOK), and a signed snapshot of subprocessors that touch the request path during the pilot. Two weeks. Can we scope and price?
Noor (SE): Clarify: they mean request/response payloads + logs/traces must remain inside EU. Control-plane metadata (job IDs, non-identifiable signals) is ok to leave EU if needed?
Alex (AE): Correct, legal said metadata-only for control-plane is acceptable. Anything that could include customer data must stay in-region.
Jakob (Infra): Technically doable: we can pin tenant to eu-west-1 and restrict routing to EU pools. BYOK via our existing KMS connector in eu-west-1 is supported. BYO-HSM is not possible for a short pilot. Need to confirm model variant availability in EU pools.
Sienna (Trust): I'll prepare a POC attestation PDF and SCQ responses. Ops must provide the subprocessors snapshot for the pilot date range and confirm observability endpoints used for this tenant. I'll include a clause: no cross-border failover during pilot without 24h written notice.
Marco (Pricing): Single-region pinning + dedicated reserved capacity and BYOK connector increase cost. Preliminary two-week estimate:  ~  (will post proper numbers ASAP).
Noor (SE): Proposed minimal POC checklist:
- duration: 14 days
- tenant residency: pinned to eu-west-1 (with eu-central-1 warm standby inside EU only)
- KMS: customer key ARN mapped into tenant via connector
- observability: EU-only sinks for traces/metrics/logs for pilot window
- routing: strict_residency=true, fallback=queue_notify
- subprocessors: ops to provide a dated snapshot for the pilot interval
Jakob (Infra): Implementation snippet: 
```
tenant_id: finpilot-2026
residency: EU
pools:
  primary: eu-west-1
  standby: eu-central-1
kms: external_key_arn: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd
routing:
  strict_residency: true
  fallback: queue_notify
observability: sink: obs-eu.redwood
```
Jakob (Infra): Notes: strict_residency=true limits autoscale to EU capacity. If pool saturates we will queue or return 429. Manual cross-border failover only with signed approval.
Alex (AE): Customer ok with queuing during pilot but requests an escalation contact list and a 24h SLA for manual failover approvals.
Sienna (Trust): Also ask ops to redact sensitive fields from traces before retention. I'll add that to attestation.
Jakob (Infra): We can toggle observability exports for this tenant to obs-eu and apply a trace-redaction rule. I'll produce the subprocessors list (infra cloud, EU storage, EU monitoring vendor) as a CSV snapshot dated for the pilot window.
Marco (Pricing): I'll produce a clean quote including reserved GPU hours, setup/oncall support, and BYOK connector mapping. Will link internal quote here when ready.
ops-bot: residency-pin apply requested for tenant finpilot-2026 -> job#9401 queued
Alex (AE): Action items: Noor to draft tech packet + eval prompts. Jakob to provide subprocessors snapshot, confirm model variants in EU pools, and schedule the config change. Sienna to finalize attestation & SCQ. Marco to post quote. I'll send the packet to the customer after all pieces are in.
Noor (SE): I'll include a short eval harness so the customer can compare latency/quality for EU variants vs global defaults.
Marco (Pricing): Quote posted internally: https://redwood.internal/quotes/POC-1767779999 (internal link)
Sienna (Trust): Will attach signed attestation when ready.
Alex (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: aiming to have customer packet tomorrow morning.
